topic: Giving the Two-Week Notice at a Job

script.title: THE LAST TWO WEEKS
script.scene_zh: 烘焙坊辦公室 · 遞辭呈
script.story_hook: A short letter, two weeks left, one big goodbye.
script.intro_zh: 一封短信、兩週倒數、一場大大方方的道別。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to a bakery back office at dusk. Listen for parting words that stay kind.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到傍晚的烘焙坊辦公室。留意溫柔體面的道別說法。
script.outro: And that is a goodbye handled with grace. Listen again and repeat out loud.
script.outro_zh: 一場體面的道別就這麼完成。再聽一次，大聲跟著說。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a young man in his mid twenties with shoulder-length wavy brown hair tied in a half knot, a thin mustache, a heather grey hoodie, dark jeans, work boots, and a wiry runner's build
script.char_b_description: a warm stout woman in her late fifties with iron-grey hair pulled into a low bun, gold hoop earrings, an olive green knit cardigan over a flour-dusted apron, and reading glasses on a beaded chain

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got a minute? There's something I need to say.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ə ˈmɪnɪt ðɛɹz ˈsʌmθɪŋ aɪ nid tə seɪ/
dialogue.zh: 有空嗎？我有件事想當面跟您說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Always, close the door. Tea? You look pale.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlˌweɪ kloʊz ðə dɔɹ ti ju lʊk ˈpeɪl/
dialogue.zh: 有，門關上。要喝茶嗎？你臉色好白。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No tea, thank you. I'm resigning, actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ti θæŋk ju aɪm ɹɪˈzaɪnɪŋ ˈæktʃuəli/
dialogue.zh: 不喝茶，謝謝。其實，我要離職了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Resigning... um, okay. Say that once more, slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹɪˈzaɪnɪŋ ʌm oʊˈkeɪ seɪ ðæt wʌns mɔɹ ˈsloʊli/
dialogue.zh: 離職……呃，好。請你慢慢再說一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm leaving at two weeks, my notice starts today.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm ˈlivɪŋ æt tu wikz maɪ ˈnoʊɾəs stɑɹts təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我再待兩週，今天正式遞上辭呈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two weeks... ha, the bakery will collapse without you.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu wikz hɑ ðə ˈbeɪkɚi wɪl kəˈlæps aʊtˈðaʊt ju/
dialogue.zh: 兩週……哈，店內沒你會垮掉的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It won't, you taught three of us the whole menu.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt woʊnt ju tɔ θɹi əv ʌs ðə hoʊl ˈmɛnju/
dialogue.zh: 不會的，整套菜單您已經教過我們三個人了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Where to, if I can ask? New job? School?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛɹ tu ɪf aɪ kən æsk nju dʒɑb skul/
dialogue.zh: 如果方便問，要去哪裡？新工作？還是讀書？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The fire academy, I got the state spot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈfaɪɹ əˈkædəmi aɪ ɡɑt ðə steɪt spɑt/
dialogue.zh: 消防訓練學院，我考上州裡的名額了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No way, you? The quiet one from the van run?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ weɪ ju ðə ˈkwaɪət wʌn fɹəm ðə væn ɹʌn/
dialogue.zh: 開玩笑吧——你？那個開送貨車很安靜的夥計？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's him. Turns out, loud calls my name now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ɪm tɜɹnz aʊt laʊd kɔlz maɪ ˈneɪm naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 就是他。原來那聲音一直在呼喚我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, your dad would grin from ear to ear.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl jɔɹ dæd wʊd ɡɹɪn fɹʌm ɪr tə ˈɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，你爸爸聽了肯定從這耳根笑到那耳根。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, he already texted seventeen excited paragraphs.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ hi ˈɔlˌɛɾi tɛkst ˈsɛvənˈtin ɪkˈsaɪɾɪd ˈpɑɹəˌɡɹæfs/
dialogue.zh: 哈，他已經傳了十七段興奮的長訊息了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So, we do this right, a proper goodbye plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wi du ðɪs ɹaɪt ə ˈpɹɑpɚ ˌɡʊdˈbaɪ plæn/
dialogue.zh: 那我們就正式來，好好安排這場道別。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, and um, I wrote it all on one page.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd ʌm aɪ ɹoʊt ɪt ɔl ɑn wʌn peɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 好，呃，我把一切濃縮在一頁紙上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One page, the famous two-week letter, let's see.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn peɪdʒ ðə ˈfeɪməz tu wik ˈlɛɾɚ lɛts si/
dialogue.zh: 一頁紙，傳說的兩週辭呈，我來看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's short on purpose, thank-you, date, handover.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ʃɔɹt ɑn ˈpɜɹpəs θæŋk ju deɪt ˈhændˌoʊvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 我是故意寫短的：感謝、日期、交接。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clean, honest, not a single guilty sentence. Good.
dialogue.phonetic: /klin ˈɑnəst nɑt ə ˈsɪŋɡəl ˈɡɪɾi ˈsɛntəns ɡʊd/
dialogue.zh: 乾淨、誠實，一句心虛的話都沒有。很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I say more in it, about the why?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ seɪ mɔɹ ɪn ɪt əˈbaʊt ðə waɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我需要多寫一點原因嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, keep the letter short, tell me reasons here.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ kip ðə ˈlɛɾɚ ʃɔɹt tɛl mi ˈɹizənz hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 不用，信寫短就好，原因留著當面說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, here's my handover list, everything in columns.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ hɪɹz maɪ ˈhændˌoʊvɚ lɪst ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ ɪn ˈkɑləmz/
dialogue.zh: 那，這是我的交接清單，所有東西都分了欄。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ovens, orders, the lemon tart recipe. You joke.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊvənz ˈɔɹdɚz ðə ˈlɛmən tɑɹt ˈrɛsəpi ju dʒok/
dialogue.zh: 烤箱、訂單、檸檬塔食譜——你開玩笑的吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's going in the binder, with the fix notes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈɡoʊɪŋ ɪn ðə ˈbaɪndɚ wɪð ðə fɪks noʊts/
dialogue.zh: 食譜會放進文件夾，連同修正筆記一起。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're serious. Then the whole team gets lessons.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ˈsɪɹiəs ðɛn ðə hoʊl tim ɡɛts ˈlɛsənz/
dialogue.zh: 你是認真的。那整個團隊都要開課了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll train Mara on the early bread shift first.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl tren ˈmɑɹə ɑn ði ˈɜɹli bɛd ʃɪft fɝst/
dialogue.zh: 我會先帶瑪拉上手清晨的麵包班。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, she asks smart questions, like you once.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ʃi æskz smɑɹt ˈkwɛstʃənz laɪk ju wʌns/
dialogue.zh: 好，她愛問聰明問題，跟你當年一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What's the paperwork side, when's my final check?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑts ðə ˈpeɪɚˌwɜɹk saɪd wɛnz maɪ ˈfaɪnəl tʃɛk/
dialogue.zh: 那紙面作業呢？我最後一張薪資哪天發？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your last day is the twenty-second, check that.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔɹ læst deɪ ɪz ðə ˈtwɛnti ˈsɛkənd tʃɛk ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 最後工作日是二十二號，先對好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty-second, yes. Does vacation pay cash out too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti ˈsɛkənd jɛs dʌz veˈkeɪʃən peɪ kæʃ aʊt tu/
dialogue.zh: 二十二號，對。未休完的假會折算成錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two days left, we pay them, that's the rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu deɪz lɛft wi peɪ ðɛm ðæts ðə ɹul/
dialogue.zh: 還剩兩天，會折現，規定如此。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice. And the keys, do I hand them over?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs ænd ðə kiz du aɪ hænd ðɛm ˈoʊvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 好。那鑰匙呢，我要交出來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keys, badge, aprons, all on the twenty-second.
dialogue.phonetic: /kiz bædʒ ˈeɪpɹənz ɔl ɑn ðə ˈtwɛnti ˈsɛkənd/
dialogue.zh: 鑰匙、識別證、圍裙，全部二十二號歸還。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All three aprons are washed and folded, promise.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl θɹi ˈeɪpɹənz ɑɹ wɑʃt ænd ˈfoʊldəd ˈpɹɑməs/
dialogue.zh: 三條圍裙我都洗好摺好了，說真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See, this is why leaving hurts a little.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ðɪs ɪz waɪ ˈlivɪŋ hɜɹts ə ˈlɪɾəl/
dialogue.zh: 看，這就是為什麼離開會有點心痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It hurts me too, this place shaped my hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt hɜɹts mi tu ðɪs pleɪs ʃeɪzd maɪ hænz/
dialogue.zh: 我也心痛，這地方練成了我這雙手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then know the door stays open, recipes too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn noʊ ðə dɔɹ steɪz ˈoʊpən ˈrɛsəpɪz tu/
dialogue.zh: 那你要知道，這扇門永遠開著，食譜也是。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? Can I pop in on busy mornings?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹɪli kæn aɪ pɑp ɪn ɑn ˈbɪzi ˈmɔɹnɪŋz/
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？我可以在忙碌的早晨回來看看嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if you bring the donut peace offering.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ɪf ju brɪŋ ðə ˈdoʊnət pis ˈɔfəɹɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 只要你帶甜甜圈來示好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, deal. Now, may I ask a self-ish thing?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ dil naʊ me aɪ æsk ə sɛlf ɪʃ θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，成交。那，我可以問個自己的事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shoot, it's a goodbye, no long lines today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃut ɪts ə ˌɡʊdˈbaɪ noʊ lɔŋ laɪnz təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 問吧，今天是道別日，不用排隊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I keep you as a job reference later?
dialogue.phonetic: /me aɪ kip ju æz ə dʒɑb ˈɛfəɹəns ˈleɪɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 之後求職，我可以請您當推薦人嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Theo, you can call at six a.m. screaming.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθioʊ ju kən kɔl æt sɪks eɪ ˈɛm ˈskɹimɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 西奧，就算清晨六點打電話哭訴都行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, noted, six a.m., I'll keep it civil.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈnoʊɾəd sɪks eɪ ˈɛm aɪl kip ɪt ˈsɪvəl/
dialogue.zh: 哈，記下了，六點，我會保持體面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And bring the academy letter, we'll frame it here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd brɪŋ ði əˈkædəmi ˈlɛɾɚ wil freɪm ɪt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 把學院的信帶來，我們要把它裝框掛這兒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's just a printout, um, but I'll bring it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts dʒʌst ə ˈpɹɪntˌaʊt ʌm bʌt aɪl brɪŋ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那只是張列印單，呃，但我會帶來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's the first dream you ever baked, keep it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ðə fɜɹst drim ju ˈɛvɚ beɪkt kip ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 這是親手烤出的第一個夢想，留好它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sandra, thank you truly, you saw me at seventeen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsændɹə θæŋk ju ˈtɹuli ju sɔ mi æt ˈsɛvənˈtin/
dialogue.zh: 桑德菈，真心謝謝您，您在我十七歲時就收留我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You swept floors before you ever touched a whisk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju swɛpt flɔɹz bɪˈfɔɹ ju ˈɛvɚ tʊtʃt ə wɪsk/
dialogue.zh: 在碰打蛋器之前，你先掃了好久的地。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And you never once mentioned the hairnet disaster.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ju ˈnɛvɚ wʌns ˈmɛnʃənd ðə ˈhɛɹnɛt dɪˈzæstɚ/
dialogue.zh: 而您從頭到尾都沒提過髮網那次災難。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some mysteries stay mysteries. That's how I manage.
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌm ˈmɪstəɹiz steɪ ˈmɪstəɹiz ðæts haʊ aɪ ˈmænədʒ/
dialogue.zh: 有些謎，就讓它永遠是謎，這就是我的管理之道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! Well, I'll make these two weeks shine bright.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ wɛl aɪl meɪk ðiz tu wikz ʃaɪn braɪt/
dialogue.zh: 哈！好，最後兩週我會站好最後一崗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And I'll plan the farewell, candles, cake, everything.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd aɪl plæn ðə fɛɹˈwɛl ˈkændəlz keɪk ɛvɹiˈθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我會辦一場歡送會，蠟燭、蛋糕一樣不缺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cake after nine, the display case holds one slice.
dialogue.phonetic: /keɪk ˈæftɚ naɪn ðə dɪˈspleɪ kez hoʊldz wʌn slaɪs/
dialogue.zh: 九點後的蛋糕，展示櫃裡留了一塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You saved me a slice already? Fine, I'll cry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju seɪvd mi ə slaɪs ɔlˈɛɾdi faɪn aɪl kraɪ/
dialogue.zh: 你已經幫我留了一塊？好了，我要哭了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Honestly, my chest agrees before my head does.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑnəstli maɪ tʃɛst əˈɡɹiz bɪˈfɔɹ maɪ hɛd dʌz/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，我的心比腦子先點頭同意了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then leave proud, the fire trucks need you, Theo.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn liv praʊd ðə ˈfaɪɹ trʌks nid ju ˈθioʊ/
dialogue.zh: 那就驕傲地走吧，消防車等著你了，西奧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll carry this place in my bag with the gloves.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl ˈkæɹi ðɪs pleɪs ɪn maɪ bæɡ wɪð ðə ɡlʌvz/
dialogue.zh: 我會把這裡連同隔熱手套一起收進包包。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gloves stay, they're part of the oven's soul, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡloʊvz steɪ ðɛɹ pɑɹt əv ði ˈʌvənz soʊl hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 手套留下吧，它們是烤箱靈魂的一部分，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, fine, gloves stay, the heart comes with me. Bye.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ faɪn ɡloʊvz steɪ ðə hɑɹt kʌmz wɪð mi baɪ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，好吧，手套留下，心我帶走。再見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bye Theo, the academy's lucky, the door stays open.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ˈθioʊ ði əˈkædəmɪz ˈlʌki ðə dɔɹ steɪz ˈoʊpən/
dialogue.zh: 再見西奧，學院好有福氣，這扇門永遠開著。

script.youtube_title: 【兩週辭呈怎麼遞📄】「這裡練成了我這雙手」烘焙坊道別全對話🎧｜交接清單・最後薪資・歡送蛋糕🍰🕯️｜聽完好好說再見｜Two-Week Notice
script.youtube_title_en: "This Place Shaped My Hands" — Giving My Two-Week Notice With Grace
script.youtube_description:
「這裡練成了我這雙手」——離職的兩週通知，該怎麼在傍晚的烘焙坊裡好好說出口？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在烤爐旁的小辦公室。

你會聽到：遞上辭呈的艱難開場、離職信為什麼要寫短、交接清單與食譜文件夾、最後一張薪資與未休假的折算、歸還鑰匙與識別證、請長官當推薦人的勇氣，還有蠟燭蛋糕的溫柔收尾。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，夾著美國人真實口語的小語感：um、well、so、ha、no way。聽完你就會用：There's something I need to say、my notice starts today、Does vacation pay cash out too?、May I keep you as a job reference later。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與開通小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"This place shaped my hands" — how do you hand in a two-week notice at a bakery without breaking hearts? This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set in a warm back office at closing time.

You will hear: opening the hard talk, why the resignation letter stays short, a handover binder full of recipes, the final paycheck and unused vacation cash-out, returning keys and badges, asking for a reference, and a farewell with candles and cake.

Everything stays in A2-level words with the small sounds Americans really use: um, well, so, ha, no way. By the end you'll own phrases like There's something I need to say, My notice starts today, and May I keep you as a job reference later.

The back half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

在烘焙坊長大的年輕麵包師，要帶著消防學院的名額離開，那封兩週辭呈該怎麼遞才溫柔？未休的假、最後一張薪資、圍裙與鑰匙，一件件怎麼辦？
